incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Canary /v2/exp-router shows 5xx spike (p95 latency stable) — started 2026-02-18T12:03:54Z

sre_pager: paging @oncall (pager duty) :rotating_light:

oncall: on call, investigating now. giving a quick summary?

alex: seeing increased 502s from the canary instances in us-west-2. stack traces point to upstream timeout when calling prompt-embed-service. sample log:
```
2026-02-18T12:03:31Z ERROR handler.go:142 upstream: timeout after 3s req_id=abcd1234
```

maria: is this the new experimental router rollout? if so we should cut traffic off to it ASAP.

oncall: yes, deployment id exp-router-2026-02-18-1. Suggesting feature-flag kill-switch. can someone flip ff?

deploy-bot: Note: Feature flag API available. Run `redwood-ff toggle --flag exp_router_enabled --env prod --value false`

alex: executing kill-switch now. running command in infra ops channel.

alex: `redwood-ff toggle --flag exp_router_enabled --env prod --value false` -> response: OK (target scope: canary+staging)

maria: flipping for canary -> OFF. monitoring ingress. :eyes:

oncall: seeing immediate drop in 5xx on canary host group. p95 unchanged, overall error rate trending down in the last 30s.

meera: customer-impact: ~11% of traffic had touched the canary routing rules; of those ~6% returned transient 5xx. CS: prepping message for customers who opened tickets.

customer-success: alerted customers A and B via email and Slack DM. logged CS ticket #CS-4829.

jamal: proposed next steps: keep flag OFF, run a rollback of exp-router for canary only, and run a targeted fix to upstream timeouts (increase client timeout + circuit breaker).

oncall: rolling back canary deployment exp-router-2026-02-18-1 -> exp-router-2026-02-17-stable (one replica at a time).

deploy-bot: Canary rollback started. CI/CD job id: ci-99823. Progress: 1/3 replicas replaced.

oncall: telemetry shows error-rate returning to baseline after replica 2 replaced.

jamal: tagging a follow-up action item: add guardrails to route to only use new path if upstream responds within 2s, and add canary-level QPS cap.

meera: CS assessing customer impact window: 12:03:31Z - 12:05:00Z, affected customers contacted, no major data loss reported.

maria: noting for postmortem: bad rollback of config in exp-router introduced stricter upstream timeouts that exposed upstream fragility. root cause analysis next.

oncall: handing off to night oncall @tanvi for monitoring and to shepherd the postmortem. please monitor for 2h and escalate if error rate >0.5% above baseline.

tanvi: ack — will watch dashboards and keep CS looped in.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigation applied: feature flag off + canary rollback). Monitoring window started. Primary oncall: oncall -> handoff to tanvi.

alex: :thumbsup: good catch, nice quick kill-switch action.

meera: scheduling postmortem runbook doc and severity assessment. I'll open the incident ticket and invite eng-runtime + infra + CS.

customer-success: closing loop: sent follow-up note to impacted customers with mitigation and ETA for RCA.

incident-bot: thread auto-archived after handoff.
